news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 221% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). news.title: iStreet Network Limited announced that it has received INR 230.325002 million in funding from Milestone Movies Private Limited and other investors
news.body: On December 4, 2025, iStreet Network Limited closed the transaction. The company issued 22,000,001 equity shares at an issue price of INR 6 for gross proceeds of INR 132,000,006 and 65,549,997 warrants at an issue price of INR 1.5 for gross proceeds of INR 98,324,995.5 for gross proceeds of INR 230,325,001.5. The warrant exercise price will be of INR 4.5. The transaction includes participation from Milestone Movies Private Limited for 833,333 shares and 833,333 warrants, Alpesh Desai  for 1,666,667 shares, Rahul Shah  for 416,667 shares, Mridul Munet  for 833,334 shares and 833,333 warrants, Ganesh Jadhav for 833,333 shares, Tejpal Salian for 416,667 warrants and other investors. The company has received approval from the board of directors.
